programmes.t: RiffTrax Presents: Bride of the Gorilla
programmes.d: She's a bride. He's a gorilla. What happens when they meet and fall in love in the jungles of South America? Murder and mayhem, that's what! This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

The Girl From Rio is about the island nation of Femina, which is inhabited by superwomen. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).
It's definitive, universal…Things is the worst movie we've ever done. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from MST3K.

RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 50's sci-fi classic! It's a tale of a man who transforms into a violent lizard creature whenever he is in the sun too long!

A sleepy mountain town called Pine Ridge has a big problem: someone's been mutilating their cows. Ah, it must be the giant from the title of the movie, you're probably thinking. Spoiler alert: nope! Join Mike, Kevin and Bill to find out!
The youth of today, no longer content to roll a hoop with a stick, play endless hours of mumbly peg, or work a lathe at a factory 14 hours a day for just pennies, need something to occupy them.
Father Frost may just be one of the greatest love stories of our time! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programmes.t: Rifftrax Shorts: What Are Letters For? And What Makes Things Float?
programmes.d: Here are two classic RiffTrax shorts, What Makes Things Float & What Are Letters For. RiffTrax Mike, Kevin, and Bill provide a comedic commentary on this parody of the original movie.

There is absolutely nothing else in the RiffTrax catalog like Dangerous Men. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

You'll laugh, you'll cry, and you probably won't be so silent about the great deal of rage you'll feel. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from MST3K.
What is fifth-grader Charlie hiding from his family, his classmates, the customers on his newspaper route? This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.
